general.label: General
general.description: Lore, Custom Name, Unbreakable and more

settings.label: Settings
settings.description: CraftEngine item settings (Tags, Fuel Time, Repair …)

blockSettings.label: Block Settings
blockSettings.description: Properties of the placed block (Hardness, Sounds, Tags, Loot …)

blockBehavior.label: Block Behavior
blockBehavior.description: The options of the block’s behavior (sounds, growth, storage …)

events.label: Events
events.description: What the item, its block or its furniture does on a click, a break and more

loot.label: Loot
loot.description: What the block or the furniture drops when it breaks

dataLore.label: Lore
dataLore.description: Text lines below the item name (MiniMessage, e.g. '<'gray>).

dataCustomName.label: Custom Name
dataCustomName.description: A name that overrides the display name, like one given in an anvil. Italic unless you turn it off.

dataUnbreakable.label: Unbreakable
dataUnbreakable.description: The item does not lose durability.

dataHideTooltip.label: Hide Tooltip
dataHideTooltip.description: Hides the tooltip lines of these components.

dataPdc.label: PDC
dataPdc.description: Custom data in the PersistentDataContainer of the item, for other plugins.

translations.label: Translations
translations.description: The item name per Minecraft language. ResourcepackBuilder writes them to the pack's lang files and sets data.item_name to its lang key. The display name is the English (en_us) text unless you set en_us here.
translations.hint: Players see the name in their Minecraft language. Languages without a text show the en_us text.

template.label: Template
template.description: Builds the whole item from templates of the project (see Templates). The keys set here are merged over those of the templates.
template.hint: CraftEngine fills $'{'__NAMESPACE__'}' and $'{'__ID__'}' with the namespace and id of the item.

arguments.label: Arguments
arguments.description: The values for the placeholders of the item's templates.

clientBoundMaterial.label: Client Bound Material
clientBoundMaterial.description: The material players see. The server keeps the real material.

dataInsertLore.label: Insert Lore
dataInsertLore.description: Inserts lines into the lore at a position.

dataRemoveLore.label: Remove Lore
dataRemoveLore.description: Removes the lore lines that match a regular expression.

dataTooltipStyle.label: Tooltip Style
dataTooltipStyle.description: The background texture of the tooltip.

dataDyedColor.label: Dyed Color
dataDyedColor.description: The color of dyeable items such as leather armor, as r,g,b.

dataTrim.label: Trim
dataTrim.description: An armor trim with pattern and material.

dataProfile.label: Profile
dataProfile.description: The skin of a player head: a player name, a texture URL or base64.

dataFood.label: Food
dataFood.description: Food values when eaten. The item also needs a consumable component to be edible.

dataEquippable.label: Equippable
dataEquippable.description: The item can be worn in an equipment slot.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

dataUseRemainder.label: Use Remainder
dataUseRemainder.description: The item that is left after using this one.

dataAttributeModifiers.label: Attribute Modifiers
dataAttributeModifiers.description: Vanilla attribute modifiers, e.g. more attack damage in the main hand.

dataPaintingVariant.label: Painting Variant
dataPaintingVariant.description: The painting a painting item places.

dataJukeboxPlayable.label: Jukebox Playable
dataJukeboxPlayable.description: The song a jukebox plays with this item.

dataExternal.label: External
dataExternal.description: Takes the data of an item from another plugin.

dataComponents.label: Components
dataComponents.description: Raw vanilla data components. CraftEngine does not check them across versions.

dataRemoveComponents.label: Remove Components
dataRemoveComponents.description: Removes these components from the item.

clientBoundData.label: Client Bound Data
clientBoundData.description: Item data that is only sent to players and resolved for each of them, such as conditional names and lore.
clientBoundData.hint: Takes the same keys as data. Use conditional#name entries for data that depends on conditions.

settingsTags.label: Tags
settingsTags.description: Item tags the item belongs to, e.g. for recipes.

settingsFuelTime.label: Fuel Time
settingsFuelTime.description: How long the item burns as furnace fuel, in ticks.

settingsFuelRemainder.label: Fuel Remainder
settingsFuelRemainder.description: The item left in the furnace after burning. Only for items that do not stack.

settingsBreakPower.label: Break Power
settingsBreakPower.description: Mining level of the tool. Blocks with a required break power need at least this value.

settingsRepairable.label: Repairable
settingsRepairable.description: Whether the item can be repaired in a crafting table, anvil or grindstone.

settingsAnvilRepairItem.label: Anvil Repair Item
settingsAnvilRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs in an anvil.

settingsDragRepairItem.label: Drag Repair Item
settingsDragRepairItem.description: Set on a repair material: the items it repairs when dropped onto them in the inventory.

settingsRespectRepairableComponent.label: Respect Repairable Component
settingsRespectRepairableComponent.description: The anvil follows the vanilla repairable component of the item.

settingsRenameable.label: Renameable
settingsRenameable.description: Whether the item can be renamed in an anvil.

settingsEnchantable.label: Enchantable
settingsEnchantable.description: Whether the item can be used in an enchanting table.

settingsPreventBreak.label: Prevent Break
settingsPreventBreak.description: The item keeps its last durability point instead of breaking.

settingsCanPlace.label: Can Place
settingsCanPlace.description: Whether the vanilla block of the material can be placed.

settingsDyeable.label: Dyeable
settingsDyeable.description: Whether the item can be dyed in a crafting table.

settingsDyeColor.label: Dye Color
settingsDyeColor.description: The color the item adds in dye recipes, as r,g,b.

settingsFireworkColor.label: Firework Color
settingsFireworkColor.description: The color the item adds to a firework star fade, as r,g,b.

settingsEquipment.label: Equipment
settingsEquipment.description: Applies a CraftEngine equipment definition when the item is worn.

damageOnHurt.label: Takes damage when the wearer is hit

equipOnInteract.label: Can be put on a mob by using it

armor.label: CustomArmor (Armor, Elytra, Mob Armor, Harness, Saddles)
armor.description: Texture shown when worn: player armor, elytra wings, armor for wolf/horse/llama/nautilus, harness for the happy ghast, or saddles. ResourcepackBuilder generates an equipment model in the pack and an entry in equipments.yml from it, and sets settings.equipment (equipment ID and, without an armor material, the slot).
armor.hint: All parts of a set get the same set ID; the textures only need to be uploaded on one part. Elytras, animal armor and saddles each need their own set ID. CraftEngine has no allowed animals: animal armor fits any animal with that slot.

elytra.label: Elytra wings
elytra.help: Like elytra.png. Without material ELYTRA, ResourcepackBuilder adds the glider component automatically.

saddles.label: Saddles (1.21.5+)
saddles.help: A saddle can have textures for several animals.

settingsConsumeReplacement.label: Consume Replacement
settingsConsumeReplacement.description: The item a player gets back after consuming this one.

settingsCraftRemainder.label: Craft Remainder
settingsCraftRemainder.description: The item left in the crafting grid after crafting.

settingsAllowedProjectiles.label: Allowed Projectiles
settingsAllowedProjectiles.description: Items a bow or crossbow can shoot.

settingsIngredientSubstitute.label: Ingredient Substitute
settingsIngredientSubstitute.description: Vanilla items this item can stand in for in recipes.

settingsCompostProbability.label: Compost Probability
settingsCompostProbability.description: Chance that the item raises the composter level (0–1).

settingsInvulnerable.label: Invulnerable
settingsInvulnerable.description: Damage causes a dropped item survives.

settingsKeepOnDeathChance.label: Keep On Death Chance
settingsKeepOnDeathChance.description: Chance that a player keeps the item on death (0–1).

settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.label: Destroy On Death Chance
settingsDestroyOnDeathChance.description: Chance that the item is destroyed on death (0–1).

settingsGlowColor.label: Glow Color
settingsGlowColor.description: The glow color of the dropped item.

settingsProjectile.label: Projectile
settingsProjectile.description: A custom projectile entity, e.g. for a trident.

blockSettingsTemplate.label: Template
blockSettingsTemplate.description: Takes the block settings from templates: CraftEngine's default templates (default:settings/…, default:hardness/…, default:sound/…, default:burn_data/…) or the project's own. Later templates win over earlier ones.
blockSettingsTemplate.hint: The settings set here are merged over those of the templates: values replace theirs, lists are added to theirs.

blockSettingsArguments.label: Arguments
blockSettingsArguments.description: The values for the placeholders of the settings templates, e.g. break_power for default:settings/ore.

blockSettingsHardness.label: Hardness
blockSettingsHardness.description: How long the block takes to break. Stone has 1.5, obsidian 50.

blockSettingsResistance.label: Resistance
blockSettingsResistance.description: How well the block withstands explosions.

blockSettingsTags.label: Tags
blockSettingsTags.description: Block tags of the block, e.g. the tool that mines it fast (minecraft:mineable/pickaxe).

blockSettingsSounds.label: Sounds
blockSettingsSounds.description: The sounds of the block: break, step, place, hit while mining and fall.

blockSettingsCorrectTools.label: Correct Tools
blockSettingsCorrectTools.description: Tools or item tags that get the drops. Setting it turns on Require Correct Tools.

blockSettingsRequireCorrectTools.label: Require Correct Tools
blockSettingsRequireCorrectTools.description: The block drops something only when it is mined with a correct tool.

blockSettingsRequiredBreakPower.label: Required Break Power
blockSettingsRequiredBreakPower.description: The break power a tool needs: wood and gold 1, stone and copper 2, iron 3, diamond 4, netherite 5.

blockSettingsIncorrectToolDigSpeed.label: Incorrect Tool Dig Speed
blockSettingsIncorrectToolDigSpeed.description: Dig speed with a wrong tool, as a share of the normal speed (0 to 1).

blockSettingsLuminance.label: Luminance
blockSettingsLuminance.description: The light level the block gives off (0 to 15).

blockSettingsMapColor.label: Map Color
blockSettingsMapColor.description: The color id of the block on maps, e.g. 11 for stone.

blockSettingsPushReaction.label: Push Reaction
blockSettingsPushReaction.description: What a piston does with the block.

blockSettingsInstrument.label: Instrument
blockSettingsInstrument.description: The sound of a note block that stands on the block.

blockSettingsBurnable.label: Burnable
blockSettingsBurnable.description: Fire from the surroundings can set the block alight.

blockSettingsBurnChance.label: Burn Chance
blockSettingsBurnChance.description: How likely the block catches fire (0 to 100).

blockSettingsFireSpreadChance.label: Fire Spread Chance
blockSettingsFireSpreadChance.description: How likely fire on the block spreads to its neighbors (0 to 100).

blockSettingsReplaceable.label: Replaceable
blockSettingsReplaceable.description: Placing another block on it replaces it, like grass.

blockSettingsIsSuffocating.label: Is Suffocating
blockSettingsIsSuffocating.description: Entities inside the block take suffocation damage.

blockSettingsIsViewBlocking.label: Is View Blocking
blockSettingsIsViewBlocking.description: The block blocks the view of mobs. Players still see what the model shows.

blockSettingsIsRandomlyTicking.label: Is Randomly Ticking
blockSettingsIsRandomlyTicking.description: The block gets random ticks, which some block behaviors need (growing, spreading).

blockSettingsCanOcclude.label: Can Occlude
blockSettingsCanOcclude.description: The block stops light from passing and turns grass below it into dirt.

blockSettingsBlockLight.label: Block Light
blockSettingsBlockLight.description: How much the block weakens light that passes through it (0 to 15).

blockSettingsFriction.label: Friction
blockSettingsFriction.description: How slippery the block is for mobs and items. Ice has 0.98. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsSpeedFactor.label: Speed Factor
blockSettingsSpeedFactor.description: Changes how fast mobs walk on the block. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsJumpFactor.label: Jump Factor
blockSettingsJumpFactor.description: Changes how high mobs jump from the block. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsBounceRestitution.label: Bounce Restitution
blockSettingsBounceRestitution.description: How high mobs bounce after landing on the block. Slime has 1. Players are not affected.

blockSettingsSupportShape.label: Support Shape
blockSettingsSupportShape.description: The vanilla block whose shape the block offers to neighbors, e.g. for torches on its side.

blockLoot.label: Loot
blockLoot.description: What the block drops when it breaks. default:loot_table/self drops the block itself. Without loot the block drops nothing.

blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.label: Vanilla slab
blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.description: The vanilla slab whose unused states the slab borrows (its look is replaced).
blockStatesArgumentsSlabBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses petrified_oak_slab.

blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.label: Vanilla stairs
blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.description: The vanilla stairs whose unused states the stairs borrow.
blockStatesArgumentsStairsBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses cut_copper_stairs.

blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.label: Vanilla door
blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.description: The vanilla door whose powered states the door borrows (they look the same as the unpowered ones).
blockStatesArgumentsDoorBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_door.

blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.label: Vanilla trapdoor
blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.description: The vanilla trapdoor whose powered states the trapdoor borrows.
blockStatesArgumentsTrapdoorBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_trapdoor.

blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.label: Vanilla fence gate
blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.description: The vanilla fence gate whose powered states the fence gate borrows.
blockStatesArgumentsFenceGateBaseBlock.hint: Each vanilla block can carry only one custom block. CraftEngine’s own default pack uses oak_fence_gate.

blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.label: Vanilla fence
blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.description: The vanilla fence whose collision the fence uses. Its look comes from the post and side items.
blockStatesArgumentsFenceBaseBlock.hint: Several fences may share one vanilla fence.

blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.label: Post item
blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows as the fence post.
blockStatesArgumentsFencePostItem.hint: Create two items for the post and the side, each with its model (for example with the parents block/fence_post and block/fence_side).

blockStatesArgumentsFenceSideItem.label: Side item
blockStatesArgumentsFenceSideItem.description: The item whose model CraftEngine shows for each connected side.

blockStatesArgumentsLeavesTintable.label: Biome tint
blockStatesArgumentsLeavesTintable.description: The leaves take the biome’s foliage color (the texture should be gray).

blockStatesArgumentsLeavesMaxDistance.label: Max distance
blockStatesArgumentsLeavesMaxDistance.description: How far the leaves may be from a log before they decay (vanilla 7).

blockBehaviorFeature.label: Tree feature
blockBehaviorFeature.description: The configured feature that grows from the sapling, e.g. minecraft:oak.

blockBehaviorStructure.label: Structure
blockBehaviorStructure.description: A structure that grows from the sapling instead of the feature.

blockBehaviorGrowSpeed.label: Grow speed
blockBehaviorGrowSpeed.description: Growth per random tick: the whole part is added, the fraction is the chance of one more step.

blockBehaviorLightRequirement.label: Light requirement
blockBehaviorLightRequirement.description: The least light level the block needs to grow.

blockBehaviorMaxLightRequirement.label: Max light
blockBehaviorMaxLightRequirement.description: The highest light level the block still grows at.

blockBehaviorIsBoneMealTarget.label: Bone meal
blockBehaviorIsBoneMealTarget.description: Bone meal makes the crop grow.

blockBehaviorBoneMealAgeBonus.label: Bone meal bonus
blockBehaviorBoneMealAgeBonus.description: How many stages one bone meal adds.

blockBehaviorBoneMealSuccessChance.label: Bone meal chance
blockBehaviorBoneMealSuccessChance.description: The chance that bone meal shows its success particles.

blockBehaviorCanOpenWithHand.label: Opens by hand
blockBehaviorCanOpenWithHand.description: A right click opens and closes the block (or switches the light).

blockBehaviorCanOpenByWindCharge.label: Opens by wind charge
blockBehaviorCanOpenByWindCharge.description: A wind charge opens and closes the block.

blockBehaviorSounds.label: Sounds
blockBehaviorSounds.description: The sounds when the block opens and closes.

blockBehaviorConnectableBlockTag.label: Connects to
blockBehaviorConnectableBlockTag.description: The block tag of the fences this fence connects to.

blockBehaviorCanLeash.label: Leash
blockBehaviorCanLeash.description: Leads can be tied to the fence.

blockBehaviorSeats.label: Seats
blockBehaviorSeats.description: Where players sit, as "x,y,z" from the block’s center, optionally with a fixed yaw ("0,0,0 90").
blockBehaviorSeats.hint: Right-clicking the block seats the player.

blockBehaviorTitle.label: Title
blockBehaviorTitle.description: The title of the storage window (MiniMessage).

blockBehaviorRows.label: Rows
blockBehaviorRows.description: How many rows of slots the storage has (1 to 6).

blockBehaviorHasSignal.label: Comparator signal
blockBehaviorHasSignal.description: A comparator reads how full the storage is.

blockBehaviors.label: More behaviors
blockBehaviors.description: Further behaviors as a YAML list (type plus its keys). The export writes them before the behavior above.
blockBehaviors.hint: Every behavior of the CraftEngine wiki works here, e.g. falling_block or bush_block.

events.label: Item Events
events.description: Functions the item runs when it is clicked with, eaten, breaks and more.

blockEvents.label: Block Events
blockEvents.description: Functions the placed block runs when it is clicked, broken, stepped on and more.

furnitureEvents.label: Furniture Events
furnitureEvents.description: Functions the placed furniture runs when it is clicked, placed or broken.

furnitureLoot.label: Loot
furnitureLoot.description: What the furniture drops when it breaks. default:loot_table/furniture drops the item it was placed with. Without loot it drops nothing.

settingsAttributeModifiers.label: Custom Attribute Modifiers
settingsAttributeModifiers.description: Modifiers of the project's custom attributes (see Attributes) while the item is in a slot. Needs CraftEngine's attribute system.

settingsEquipmentSetPart.label: Equipment Set Piece
settingsEquipmentSetPart.description: Makes the item a piece of equipment sets (see Attributes) while it is in one of the slots. Needs CraftEngine's attribute system.

slots.label: slots
slots.help: The slots in which the item counts as a piece. Slot groups such as armor are not allowed here.

sets.label: sets
sets.help: The equipment sets the item counts for.

on.label: The trigger that runs the event

conditions.label: Conditions
conditions.help: All must hold, or the functions do not run.

functions.label: Functions
functions.help: Run in this order when the event fires.

allOf.label: all_of
allOf.help: True when all terms are true.

anyOf.label: any_of
anyOf.help: True when any term is true.

hasPlayer.label: has_player
hasPlayer.help: A player is part of the context.

hasItem.label: has_item
hasItem.help: There is an item in the hand.

matchItem.label: match_item
matchItem.help: The item in the hand has one of the ids.

equipment.label: equipment
equipment.help: The item in an equipment slot matches an id or a tag.

equipmentSet.label: equipment_set
equipmentSet.help: The entity wears enough pieces of an equipment set.

count.label: count
count.help: Exact number of pieces; overrides min and max.

matchEntity.label: match_entity
matchEntity.help: The entity has one of the ids.

matchBlock.label: match_block
matchBlock.help: The block at a position has one of the ids.

matchBlockProperty.label: match_block_property
matchBlockProperty.help: The block state has these property values.

matchFurnitureVariant.label: match_furniture_variant
matchFurnitureVariant.help: The furniture shows one of the variants.

tableBonus.label: table_bonus
tableBonus.help: A chance per level of an enchantment on the tool.

chances.label: chances
chances.help: A list of chances from 0 to 1, one per level starting at level 0.

fallingBlock.label: falling_block
fallingBlock.help: The drop comes from a falling block.

enchantment.label: enchantment
enchantment.help: The item in the hand has an enchantment level.

random.label: random
random.help: True with a chance from 0 to 1.

id.label: id
id.help: Conditions with the same id share one roll.

distance.label: distance
distance.help: The player is within this distance of the position.

hasDiscoveredRecipe.label: has_discovered_recipe
hasDiscoveredRecipe.help: The player has unlocked the recipe.

regex.label: regex
regex.help: The value matches the regular expression.

isNull.label: is_null
isNull.help: The context argument is not set.

onCooldown.label: on_cooldown
onCooldown.help: The player has this cooldown (see set_cooldown).

onItemCooldown.label: on_item_cooldown
onItemCooldown.help: The item cooldown group is active (1.21.2+).

inventoryHasItem.label: inventory_has_item
inventoryHasItem.help: The inventory holds this many of the item.

openWater.label: open_water
openWater.help: The fishing bobber is in open water.

biome.label: biome
biome.help: The position is in one of the biomes.

world.label: world
world.help: The position is in one of the worlds.

js.label: js
js.help: A JavaScript function that returns true or false.

worldguardRegion.label: worldguard:region
worldguardRegion.help: The position is in WorldGuard regions (needs WorldGuard).

mode.label: mode
mode.help: 1: in any of the regions, 2: in all of them.

hasMoney.label: has_money
hasMoney.help: The player has this much money (needs Vault).

actionbar.label: actionbar
actionbar.help: Shows a text in the action bar.

merchantTrade.label: merchant_trade
merchantTrade.help: Opens a trading window with offers.

offers.label: offers
offers.help: The offers: cost_1, cost_2, result and exp each.

particle.label: particle
particle.help: Spawns particles. Particle data keys are kept as they are.

levelerExp.label: leveler_exp
levelerExp.help: Gives experience in a leveling plugin (e.g. AuraSkills, Jobs).

transfer.label: transfer
transfer.help: Sends the player to another server.

playTotemAnimation.label: play_totem_animation
playTotemAnimation.help: Plays the totem animation with an item.

setCount.label: set_count
setCount.help: Sets the count of the item in the hand.

run.label: run
run.help: Runs functions, optionally after a delay in ticks.

ifElse.label: if_else
ifElse.help: Runs the functions of the first rule whose conditions hold.

when.label: when
when.help: Runs the functions of the case that matches a text.

setVariable.label: set_variable
setVariable.help: Sets a variable of the context.

updateBlockProperty.label: update_block_property
updateBlockProperty.help: Changes properties of the block state.

transformBlock.label: transform_block
transformBlock.help: Turns the block into another, keeping matching properties.

cycleBlockProperty.label: cycle_block_property
cycleBlockProperty.help: Switches a block property to its next value.

updateInteractionTick.label: update_interaction_tick
updateInteractionTick.help: Updates the tick of the last interaction.

setFurnitureVariant.label: set_furniture_variant
setFurnitureVariant.help: Switches the furniture to another variant.

takeMoney.label: take_money
takeMoney.help: Takes money from the player (needs Vault).

add.label: add
add.help: Adds the value to the current one instead of replacing it.

target.label: target
target.help: The players it acts on: self, all, or a selector object. Unset: the player of the event.

maxAttempts.label: max_attempts
maxAttempts.help: How often a value outside min and max is rolled again.

lootTarget.label: target
lootTarget.help: The ids it applies to. Unset: all of this type. Block states are not allowed here.

overwrite.label: overwrite
overwrite.help: What to remove from the vanilla result: items, experience, all or none (default: add your loot).

lootTable.label: loot
lootTable.help: A loot template with its arguments, a loot table of your own, or the id of another loot table.

template.label: template
template.help: A loot template of CraftEngine or of another pack. default:loot_table/self drops the block itself.

arguments.label: arguments
arguments.help: The values the template fills in, such as item or count.

bonusRolls.label: bonus_rolls
bonusRolls.help: Extra rolls per point of luck.

lootFunctions.label: functions
lootFunctions.help: Change the dropped items, in this order.

lootSourceId.label: id
lootSourceId.help: The id of the loot source. Without a namespace it gets the project namespace.

weight.label: weight
weight.help: How often this entry is picked among the others of its pool (default 1).

quality.label: quality
quality.help: How much each point of luck adds to the weight.

fallback.label: fallback
fallback.help: The value when the entity lacks the vanilla attribute. Default: 0.

transform.label: transform
transform.help: An expression applied to the value read, with value as its variable.

uniform.label: uniform
uniform.help: A random number between min and max.

gaussian.label: gaussian
gaussian.help: A normally distributed number (same as normal).

binomial.label: binomial
binomial.help: The number of successes in extra tries.

weighted.label: weighted
weighted.help: One of the numbers, chosen by weight.

beta.label: beta
beta.help: A beta-distributed number between min and max.

attack.label: attack
attack.help: The item hits an entity (also hit).

consume.label: consume
consume.help: The item is eaten or drunk (also eat, drink).

pickUp.label: pick_up
pickUp.help: The item is picked up (also pick).

itemBreak.label: item_break
itemBreak.help: The item breaks when its durability runs out.

blockBreak.label: block_break
blockBreak.help: The block is broken, or the item breaks a block (also dig).

place.label: place
place.help: The block or furniture is placed (also build).

step.label: step
step.help: A player steps on the block.

fall.label: fall
fall.help: Registered, but nothing fires it yet.

blockBreak.label: block_break
blockBreak.help: A block is broken. Target: block ids.

entityDeath.label: entity_death
entityDeath.help: An entity dies. Target: entity ids.

fishing.label: fishing
fishing.help: A bobber catches something. No target.

piglinBarter.label: piglin_barter
piglinBarter.help: A piglin finishes bartering. No target.

container.label: container
container.help: A loot container is filled. Target: loot table ids.

archaeology.label: archaeology
archaeology.help: Suspicious sand or gravel is brushed. Target: loot table ids.

entityDrop.label: entity_drop
entityDrop.help: An entity drops an item (e.g. a chicken lays an egg). Target: entity ids.

harvest.label: harvest
harvest.help: A player harvests a block. Target: block ids.

blockShear.label: block_shear
blockShear.help: A player shears a block. Target: block ids.

entityShear.label: entity_shear
entityShear.help: A player shears an entity. Target: entity ids.

vault.label: vault
vault.help: A vault gives its reward. Target: loot table ids.

advancement.label: advancement
advancement.help: A player completes an advancement; the loot goes into the inventory. Target: advancement ids.

furnitureItem.label: furniture_item
furnitureItem.help: Drops the item the furniture was placed with.

item.label: item
item.help: The item it drops when the furniture has no item of its own.

empty.label: empty
empty.help: Drops nothing. Use it to give the other entries a chance to miss.

function.label: function
function.help: Runs functions instead of dropping an item.

lootTable.label: loot_table
lootTable.help: Drops the loot of another loot table.

alternatives.label: alternatives
alternatives.help: Drops the first child whose conditions hold.

ifElse.label: if_else
ifElse.help: Drops the first child whose conditions hold (a second name of alternatives).

applyBonus.label: apply_bonus
applyBonus.help: Adds items for each level of an enchantment, such as Fortune.

formula.label: formula
formula.help: How the level turns into extra items.

type.label: type
type.help: ore_drops: like vanilla ores. binomial_with_bonus_count: like vanilla crops.

explosionDecay.label: explosion_decay
explosionDecay.help: Lets an explosion destroy some of the items.

limitCount.label: limit_count
limitCount.help: Keeps the number of items between min and max.

applyData.label: apply_data
applyData.help: Changes the data of the items.

data.label: data
data.help: Item data as YAML, like the data of an item.

vanilla.label: vanilla
vanilla.help: The entity's current value of a vanilla attribute.

byEntityType.label: by_entity_type
byEntityType.help: The default value of a vanilla attribute for the entity's type.

expression.label: expression
expression.help: The result of an expression over value and base.

delta.label: delta
delta.help: Only the change from the base: value - base.

ratio.label: ratio
ratio.help: The value relative to the base: value / base.

composition.label: composition
composition.help: The sum of several parts, each its own formula.

js.label: js
js.help: The result of a JavaScript function in the pack.

lifeSteal.label: life_steal
lifeSteal.help: Heals the attacker by a share of the damage plus a fixed amount.

potionEffect.label: potion_effect
potionEffect.help: Gives the victim or the attacker a potion effect.

function.label: function
function.help: Only runs its functions (when its conditions hold).

id.label: id
id.help: Uses name the template by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

arguments.label: arguments
arguments.help: The arguments the template takes. One without a default must be passed by every use.

body.label: body
body.help: The config the template stands for, as YAML. $'{'name'}' puts in an argument, $'{'name:-value'}' an argument with a default.

id.label: id
id.help: Modifiers and formulas name the attribute by this id. Without a namespace it gets the project's.

base.label: base
base.help: The starting value: a number, or read from a vanilla attribute of the entity.

derived.label: derived
derived.help: Makes the attribute a derived one, computed from others, e.g. demo:might * 2. It then needs no base, operations or sync.

operations.label: operations
operations.help: The operations applied to the modifiers, in this order. Unset: add_value, add_multiplied_base, add_multiplied_total.

constraint.label: constraint
constraint.help: Limits the final value. Set both min and max: CraftEngine takes a missing min as just above 0.

entities.label: entities
entities.help: The entity types (or #tags) that have the attribute. Unset: all.

sync.label: sync
sync.help: Writes the value into vanilla attributes, e.g. max health.

value.label: value
value.help: The amount written: an expression over value and base, delta (value - base) or ratio (value / base). Default: value.

expression.label: expression
expression.help: Runs once for each modifier with this operation. base is the value at the start of the stage, current the value so far, amount the modifier's amount.

pieces.label: pieces
pieces.help: The bonus tiers by the number of pieces worn. Tiers do not add up: the highest one reached applies, so give it all its bonuses.

events.label: events
events.help: Functions that run once when the tier is reached and when it is left.

damageType.label: damage_type
damageType.help: The vanilla damage type the rule changes, e.g. minecraft:player_attack.

target.label: target
target.help: The victims it applies to: entity ids or #tags. Unset: the default rule for every other victim.

formula.label: formula
formula.help: The new damage: an expression such as damage + '<'attacker_attr:namespace:might>, or a composition or script.

effects.label: effects
effects.help: Effects after the damage: life steal, potion effects or functions.

type.label: type
type.help: The custom attribute the modifier changes.

id.label: id
id.help: A unique id for this modifier. CraftEngine finds, replaces and removes it by this id.

amount.label: amount
amount.help: The value given to the operation: a number, a range like 5~10, an expression or a number provider.

operation.label: operation
operation.help: How the amount is applied: a built-in operation or one of the project.

scope.label: scope
scope.help: entity: adds to the holder's attribute. weapon: only counts in damage formulas for attacks with this item. Default: entity.

slot.label: slot
slot.help: The slot or slot group in which the modifier applies (mainhand, armor, any …).

conditions.label: conditions
conditions.help: The modifier only applies while all conditions hold.

updateInterval.label: update_interval
updateInterval.help: How often a changing amount or the conditions are checked, in ticks. Default: 20.
